===Field list===
*source (Used to provide a link to the original source of the excerpt)
*attrib (Used in conjunction with the source field to provide attribution)
*color (defaults to black &ndash; #000000)
*font-family (defaults to [[Wikipedia:Sans-serif|Sans-serif]])

===Details===
This template can be used to format items in a [[Template:Multiexcerpt|excerpt list]] when multiple sources are used. It cannot be used out side of the content section of that template.
